user.title: ABB Welcome
user.description:
Pair Home Assistant with an ABB Welcome IP gateway or SmartTouch panel.

Required:
• MyBuildings portal username and password (use the portal username, not necessarily the email address).
• Local IP address of the ABB Welcome IP device.

Classic IP gateway (for example 83342): also enter the gateway web-admin password.
SmartTouch 10: leave the gateway web-admin password blank; SmartTouch exposes SIP-TLS locally and is selected from MyBuildings discovery.

Optional: Portal UUID. Use it when more than one compatible Welcome device is linked to the same MyBuildings account.

data.gateway_password: Gateway admin password (classic IP gateway only)

manual_authorize.title: Complete ABB Welcome pairing
manual_authorize.description:
The pairing request was sent successfully.

**SmartTouch 10:** open **System settings → Network connections → Welcome APP** and approve the new client `{client_name}` if the panel asks. Some SmartTouch firmware versions approve the request automatically.

**Classic IP gateway:** open `https://{gateway_ip}/`, go to Portal / App Management, select `{client_name}`, grant the required permissions and enter integrity code **{integrity_code}**.

Then click **Submit**. Home Assistant will poll MyBuildings for the signed ACL update (up to about 5 minutes).

Diagnostic detail: {error_detail}

confirm.title: Confirm Setup
confirm.description:
Pairing complete.

SIP user: `{sip_username}@{sip_domain}`
Doors discovered ({door_count}):

{door_names}

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the ABB Welcome device on HTTPS 443 or SIP-TLS 5061. Check the IP address and network routing.
error.gateway_not_found: No compatible ABB Welcome IP gateway or SmartTouch panel is visible to this MyBuildings account, or multiple devices require a Portal UUID.
error.gateway_admin_auth_failed: Classic IP gateway web-admin authentication failed. For SmartTouch 10, leave the gateway admin password blank.
error.no_pending_app: The gateway did not see our pairing request. Try again or check that the portal account is linked to this gateway.
error.integrity_code_rejected: The gateway rejected the integrity code we computed. Open an issue with your gateway firmware version.
error.gateway_admin_failed: Talking to the gateway admin CGI failed — see the Home Assistant log.
error.gateway_op6_failed: Could not read the gateway's portal UUID. Some firmware versions have a broken portal-client endpoint. Fill in the optional 'Gateway Portal UUID' field and try again.
error.invalid_uuid: Gateway Portal UUID must look like 8d24f178-9c41-4aed-97e1-6008bb6aef82 (8-4-4-4-12 hex). Leave blank to auto-detect.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.acl_timeout: The gateway did not push a configuration after pairing. Try again.
abort.acl_parse_failed: The gateway sent a configuration but it could not be parsed. Check the Home Assistant log.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error during ACL polling — see the Home Assistant log.
